versions.content: Mapping of OUT and INOUT ArgumentDataPrototype s to returnSignal s The ArgumentDataPrototype s that are returned from the op- eration (i.e. the direction is out) and the ArgumentDataPrototype s that are passed to and returned from the operation (i.e. the direction is inout) are expected to be mapped to the returnSignal by the serializer.
